description: Complete CSS restructure: demolish old token/color system, rebuild from scratch with Navy Royal + Muted Gold palette, new spacing/radius/typography tokens, proper dark theme with warm grays, and reorganize into logical CSS files. This covers Phases 1, 2, 3, and 6 of the spec.
steps: Delete ALL existing CSS files in frontend/src/styles/ (all 19 files). They will be completely replaced.

Create new frontend/src/styles/tokens.css with the following EXACT token system: PRIMARY: Navy Royal #1E3A5F, SECONDARY: Muted Gold #C4A35A, ACCENT: #3B82F6 (for actions/notifications only). Semantic: success #10B981, warning #F59E0B, error #EF4444, info #3B82F6. Neutrals: 10 shades from #FFFFFF to #111827. Spacing: --sp-1 (4px) through --sp-8 (64px) with values 4,8,12,16,24,32,48,64. Radius: --radius-sm (6px), --radius-md (10px), --radius-lg (16px), --radius-xl (24px), --radius-full (9999px). Font sizes: --fs-sm (14px), --fs-base (16px), --fs-lg (18px), --fs-xl (24px), --fs-2xl (32px), --fs-3xl (40px). ONE font: --font-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', system-ui, sans-serif. ONE mono font: --font-mono: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace. Shadows: --shadow-sm, --shadow-md, --shadow-lg ONLY (3 total). Motion: --duration-fast (150ms), --duration-base (250ms), --duration-slow (400ms). Layout: --sidebar-w: 240px, --topbar-h: 56px.

In the same tokens.css, add [data-theme='dark'] block with WARM GRAY backgrounds (NOT black): --bg: #1a1d23, --surface-1: #22262f, --surface-2: #292e38, --surface-3: #313742. Muted text: #9aa0a8. Borders: rgba(255,255,255,0.06). All shadows max opacity 0.25. Primary adapts to lighter variant in dark mode.
In tokens.css add [data-theme='light'] block: --bg: #F8FAFC, --surface-1: #FFFFFF, --surface-2: #F1F5F9, --surface-3: #E2E8F0. Text: #1E293B, muted: #64748B. Borders: #E2E8F0. Standard light shadows.

Create frontend/src/styles/reset.css: minimal CSS reset (box-sizing, margins, font-family application, html/body setup, RTL-aware defaults, ::selection, :focus-visible, smooth scrolling, img max-width, reduced-motion override for all animations/transitions).

Create frontend/src/styles/layout.css: sidebar (.sidebar) at 240px width with clean surface background, nav items with 10px radius and subtle hover. Topbar (.topbar) at 56px height. Content area (.main, .content-inner) with proper max-width and padding. Mobile overlay sidebar logic. The .page-header with clean title styling (no gradient backgrounds, no accent rails - just clean text).

Create frontend/src/styles/components.css: cards with 12px radius, 20px padding, very light border, lighter shadow. Card hover = border-color change ONLY (no transform). Buttons: height 38px primary / 34px secondary, border-radius 8px, font-weight 600. Metrics/KPIs with clean borders. Tables with thinner rows and quiet hover. Grid helpers. Form inputs. Tags/badges. Tabs. Empty states. All utility classes (flex, gap, etc).

Create frontend/src/styles/pages.css: dashboard styles (.student-dashboard, .welcome-card etc), owner page styles, PDF viewer styles. Keep functional classes but with new tokens. Welcome card: solid navy background, no floating orbs or pseudo-elements.
Create frontend/src/styles/theme-dark.css: any dark-theme-specific overrides that cannot be handled by tokens alone (e.g., image filters, specific component dark adaptations).

Create frontend/src/styles/landing.css: COMPLETE new landing page styles following Phase 4 spec. Hero: 70-80vh, big Arabic title (--fs-3xl), navy background with optional very subtle geometric SVG pattern at 3-5% opacity, gold CTA button, large whitespace. Stats bar: 4 numbers in a clean row. Features: 3-4 cards with simple icon + title + description (no huge bento grid). About section: brief text. Final CTA. Footer. Header with clean navigation. All responsive. NO chaotic gradients, NO glassmorphism, NO floating orbs, NO exaggerated hover effects. Mobile menu.

Update frontend/src/main.tsx to import ONLY the new CSS files in this order: tokens.css, reset.css, layout.css, components.css, pages.css, landing.css, theme-dark.css, theme-light.css (8 files total, down from 19).

Update frontend/index.html: remove Google Fonts link tags (Lexend, Outfit references). Keep IBM Plex Sans Arabic and Space Mono in the font-family declarations in CSS as fallback system fonts since CDN is unavailable. Update meta theme-color values to match new palette.

Ensure ALL existing CSS class names used in TSX components still have corresponding styles. Classes to preserve include: .landing, .landing-header, .landing-nav, .landing-brand, .landing-hero, .landing-title, .landing-subtitle, .landing-cta-row, .btn, .btn.primary, .btn.outline, .kpi-strip, .kpi-cell, .kpi-value, .kpi-label, .landing-features, .landing-section-head, .landing-section-eyebrow, .landing-features-title, .landing-section-lede, .landing-bento, .landing-bento-card, .landing-bento-wide, .landing-bento-icon, .landing-bento-body, .landing-bento-title, .landing-bento-desc, .landing-ai-section, .landing-feature-card, .landing-feature-icon, .landing-feature-title, .landing-feature-desc, .landing-features-grid, .landing-pilot, .landing-pilot-stat, .landing-pilot-value, .landing-pilot-label, .landing-pilot-note, .landing-proof, .landing-proof-quote, .landing-proof-source, .testimonial-card, .testimonial-quote, .testimonial-author, .testimonial-avatar, .testimonial-name, .testimonial-role, .landing-final-cta, .landing-final-cta-inner, .landing-final-cta-title, .landing-final-cta-lede, .landing-final-cta-actions, .landing-final-cta-btn, .landing-footer, .sidebar, .sidebar-brand, .sidebar-brand-mark, .sidebar-brand-text, .sidebar-brand-name, .sidebar-brand-sub, .nav-group, .nav-section-label, .nav-item, .nav-icon, .nav-label, .nav-badge, .sidebar-footer, .sidebar-user, .topbar, .topbar-mobile-toggle, .topbar-title, .card, .card.compact, .card.flush, .card-header, .card-title, .card-subtitle, .metric, .metric-icon, .metric-value, .metric-label, .grid-2, .grid-3, .grid-4, .page-header, .page-title, .page-subtitle, .theme-toggle, .theme-toggle-btn, .role-tab, .role-tabs, .student-dashboard, .welcome-card, .reveal-up, .in-view, .ministry-strip, .landing-burger, .landing-mobile-menu, .landing-header-login, .landing-hero-eyebrow, .landing-hero-content, .landing-hero-img, .landing-testimonials, .notif-panel, .notif-item, .bottom-nav, .bottom-nav-item, .ai-glow, plus all classes in owner.css and pdf.css

Remove all uses of color-mix() CSS function - replace with pre-computed rgba() or fixed hex values. Remove all references to --font-display and Lexend/Outfit fonts. Remove the cinematic theme entirely.
acceptance_criteria: Only 8 CSS files remain in styles/ directory (tokens, reset, layout, components, pages, landing, theme-dark, theme-light)
tokens.css contains exactly the specified token values - no duplicates, no extra color families
Dark theme uses warm gray backgrounds (#1a1d23, #22262f, #292e38, #313742) - never pure black
No color-mix() usage anywhere in CSS
Only IBM Plex Sans Arabic and Space Mono font references remain (no Lexend, no Outfit)
All class names referenced in TSX files have corresponding CSS rules
index.html has no Google Fonts CDN link tags
Reduced motion media query present in reset.css
verification: Run 'npx tsc -b --noEmit' in frontend/ directory to confirm no TypeScript errors
Run 'npx vite build' in frontend/ directory to confirm CSS bundles without errors
Grep for 'color-mix' in all CSS files - should return zero results
Grep for 'Lexend\|Outfit' in all CSS and HTML files - should return zero results
Count CSS files in styles/ directory - should be exactly 8
findings: TypeScript build cannot be run because node_modules is missing and INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network prevents npm install. All pre-existing TS errors are related to missing npm dependencies (react, react-router-dom, lucide-react, etc.), not CSS changes. CSS verification passes: 8 files, no color-mix(), no Lexend/Outfit, no Google Fonts CDN, all critical TSX class names have CSS definitions, warm gray dark theme, reduced-motion present.
